summary.text: Data engineer who builds and operates production data infrastructure end-to-end. Solo-built a 75 GB, 120M+ row market-data system with bitemporal point-in-time versioning.

education.degree: B.S. Computational Data Science & Statistics (Double Major)

bullets.text: Engineered a Postgres-native async ingestion pipeline across major ATS platforms, normalizing heterogeneous schemas into a shared index of 180K+ postings.
Designed a multi-tier cache with SHA-256 content-hash deduplication and cross-source identity merge, so duplicate records resolve on a $0 path.
Built the backend on FastAPI and PostgreSQL 17 with a 25-table row-level-security schema and contract-first codegen gated in CI.
Built a Python NLP pipeline that classified 150+ unstructured intelligence reports, cutting manual analysis time 60%.
Developed an anomaly-detection system flagging high-priority events at 85% precision.
Architected and operate a 75 GB PostgreSQL and TimescaleDB system across 89 tables and 18 hypertables, ingesting from 26 sources on 18 systemd timers.
Implemented bitemporal point-in-time versioning and an amendment-supersession resolver over 135K record versions.
Maintain a daily-reconciled slowly-changing entity dimension of roughly 2,800 active entities out of 3,900 historical.
Built a conditional predictive-distribution pipeline over 30 years of index data, implementing GARCH and particle-filter models from scratch.

awards.title: Mu Sigma Rho, National Statistics Honor Society
